templateRoute.reason: Al's Cafe & Creamery is a heritage-Americana chef-owned cafe/diner/creamery in the 1892 Ranstead Building with Burns Malts and broad American/New American comfort food. Existing templates either flatten the heritage/creamery character (plate/cuisine), over-index on bar/cocktail atmosphere (bramble), over-luxury/editorial restraint (roma/1776), or are cuisine/register mismatches (gusto/varro/qitchen/alinea/labrisa/etc.).

Desktop/mobile screenshots plus official-page scrapes and public directory evidence captured locally on 2026-05-06.

blocker.reason: Template gap: heritage-Americana diner/creamery / chef-owned historic cafe. Current archetypes would strip the 1892-building heritage, Burns Malts/creamery identity, and approachable chef-diner register.
blocker.nextUnblockAction: Founder/MC should either add/select a heritage-Americana diner/creamery archetype, explicitly approve a custom experimental fork, or retire/skip this lead.

decisionSummary: Keep Al's Cafe & Creamery blocked/skipped. The business is viable and has a dated/mobile-weak current site, but forcing it into Plate, Bramble, Roma/Cuisine, 1776, Gusto, or Varro would misrepresent the restaurant. Treat it as a catalog-gap signal for a future heritage-Americana diner/creamery template.
